name: Ponytail

sentences.text: Your AI agent wrote 335 lines for a date picker. This one wrote 10.
It's called Ponytail, and it puts a lazy senior dev inside your agent.
In the creator's own tests, it wrote 53% less code and cost 26% less.
But it never cuts security, and risky code still gets a test.
It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more, free and open source.
Comment PONYTAIL and I'll send you the link.

caption:
Your AI agent wrote 335 lines for a date picker. Ponytail wrote 10.

Ponytail is a free, open-source skill that puts a lazy senior dev inside your coding agent: write only what the task needs, but never cut validation, security or tests. In the creator's own benchmark (Claude Code, 39 tasks) it wrote 53% less code and cost 26% less. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.

Comment PONYTAIL and I'll DM you the link.
summary_cs: Ponytail je open-source skill/plugin pro Claude Code, Codex, Cursor a další, který agenta nutí psát jen nezbytný kód (příklad z README: date picker 335 → 10 řádků). Čísla -53 % kódu / -26 % ceny jsou z autorova vlastního benchmarku, tak to i ve videu říkám.
